verdict.rationale: Beamer collects and prioritizes feedback and offers a roadmap, so this axis applies to it. However, the only AI capability in the evidence is generating changelog posts. Nothing shows AI automatically detecting insights in feedback or linking them to feature ideas; the NPS trend identification and feedback prioritization are adjacent features with no AI insight-linking.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can rely on AI to automatically detect insights within feedback and link them to related feature ideas
